_about: Cases for the hand-docking chapter (ported from the docking_game prototype). Each refers to a pocket-hunt level by id, so the structure is shared. Thresholds are for on-page feedback only.

cases.note: Rigid, 9 heavy atoms. Only position and orientation matter.
Small and almost rigid; the sulfonamide must point at the zinc.
Biotin's tail must go in first.
Tiny, but the cavity is buried: you have to place it inside the protein.
37 heavy atoms and a long shape: orientation is everything.
